verdict.rationale: SSH connectivity is a fair question for a Unix-like terminal app on iOS, so the axis applies. Nothing in the evidence pack mentions ssh, remote server connections, or Ed25519/ECDSA/RSA key support. The listed ios_system commands (nslookup, whois, python3, lua, pdflatex) do not include ssh.

support.subject: As a developer, I can connect to remote servers using SSH with Ed25519, ECDSA, or RSA keys
